mapper.select: SELECT daily_seq, user_id, name, period, cperiod, sender, sendate, sendstatus, pdfdate, number, email, recver, naver, kakaosa, kakaomo, naverda, google, dashboard, mediaanalysis AS mediaAnalysis, campaignanalysis AS campaignAnalysis, periodanalysis AS periodAnalysis, keywordanalysis AS keywordAnalysis, adanalysis AS adAnalysis, shoppinganalysis AS shoppingAnalysis, im, clk, ctr, cpc, cst, cv, cvr, cr, cpa, roas, purchase_roas, content, daily_regdate FROM h3_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY daily_regdate DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM h3_report WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT daily_seq, user_id, name, period, cperiod, sender, sendate, sendstatus, pdfdate, number, email, recver, naver, kakaosa, kakaomo, naverda, google, dashboard, mediaanalysis, campaignanalysis, periodanalysis, keywordanalysis, adanalysis, shoppinganalysis, im, clk, ctr, cpc, cst, cv, cvr, cr, cpa, roas, purchase_roas, content, daily_regdate FROM h3_report ORDER BY daily_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h3_report ( user_id, name, period, cperiod, sender, sendate, sendstatus, pdfdate, number, email, recver, naver, kakaosa, kakaomo, naverda, google, dashboard, mediaanalysis, campaignanalysis, periodanalysis, keywordanalysis, adanalysis, shoppinganalysis, im, clk, ctr, cpc, cst, cv, cvr, cr, cpa, roas, purchase_roas, content, daily_regdate ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{period}, #{cperiod}, #{sender}, #{sendate}, #{sendstatus}, #{pdfdate}, #{number}, #{email}, #{recver}, #{naver}, #{kakaosa}, #{kakaomo}, #{naverda}, #{google}, #{dashboard}, #{mediaanalysis}, #{campaignanalysis}, #{periodanalysis}, #{keywordanalysis}, #{adanalysis}, #{shoppinganalysis}, #{im}, #{clk}, #{ctr}, #{cpc}, #{cst}, #{cv}, #{cvr}, #{cr}, #{cpa}, #{roas}, #{purchase_roas}, #{content}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO h3_report_ext (b_id, s_1, s_2, s_3) VALUES (#{bId}, #{s1}, #{s2}, #{s3})
mapper.update: UPDATE h3_report SET pdfdate = #{pdfdate} WHERE daily_seq = #{id}
